experiment: N4 causal patch on frozen N3 real-text activations

protocol.input_contract: consume frozen input_ids; no retokenization or chat template
protocol.batching: batch size one; each row and condition receives an independent full-sequence patched forward
protocol.norm_matching: all analytical non-zero substitutes rescaled to target norm; identity patches the frozen activation; the clean evaluation state is separately required to match it bit-exactly
protocol.ce_targets: the first 16 frozen next tokens after the patched position
